name: Reaper of Night — "if defending player has two or fewer cards in hand" reads the attacked player's hand as the trigger resolves
notes: Found in project_command_zone_controller_and_defending_player_hand_2026-10-14: the condition was never read, so the fired trigger gave flying at any hand size. _addAbilityPseudo strips a trigger's leading 'if [condition],' from the fired text; the site reads it at fire time (_evaluateTriggerCondition, called by fireTriggeredAbility and by this harness's fire step) and fires nothing when it is false. It now reads the hand of the player the creature attacks (_attackedPlayerId). Three players; Player 1, Reaper's controller, has no cards in hand throughout. With Player 2 at five cards and Player 3 at one, Reaper A attacks Player 3 (picked on the card) and fires: flying. Then Player 2 goes to two and Player 3 to four. Reaper B attacks Player 3: nothing fires, no flying. Reaper C attacks Player 2 (the default): flying. Reaper A keeps flying (decided as its trigger resolved). The triggerCondition asserts check the fire-time reading on the saved board, so the suite guards it without a rebuild. Memory: project_reaper_of_night_defending_player_hand_2026-10-14.
